title: No mall, but similar “hyperreal” recurring dream tower and others
content: I’ve never dreamed of a mall that I can recall, but I have had several recurring dreamscapes that feel distinctly vivid and “real” with a level of awareness, recollection and detail I don’t have in normal dreams. The longest recurring one is a large stone tower with a long circling staircase going up anti-clockwise. The stone seems rough-hewn rather than masonry. Every quarter turn there are nooks full of books or scrolls. Midway up there is a slit window, and the landscape outside is like nothing I’ve ever seen. The second one I haven’t had since I was a kid, but it was an *enormous* grassy hill next to a cliff that was a sheer drop. The sense of scale was vast, and there were always huge herds of horses. The third one is the most vivid, and it was always brief - I was standing on a platform on a step pyramid next to a tall woman looking out over a courtyard full of people and the lushest gardens imaginable. I’ve had other recurring dreams with that weird real feeling, but those are the ones I remember best. a I don’t think I’ve had the mall dream, but my boyfriend has mentioned having long, engaging post-apocalypse dreams before, he said some of his dreams feel like they last weeks.
